description: This file defines the Style class for parsing and handling style information within an XML reader for PhpSpreadsheet. It processes various style components such as Alignment, Borders, Font, Fill, NumberFormat, and Protection from XML, storing style definitions and attributes.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing style information from XML elements, storing style definitions, and managing style attributes such as alignment, borders, font, fill, number formatting, and protection settings.

methods.name: parseStyles
methods.description: Parses style definitions from a SimpleXMLElement containing style XML data, extracting various style attributes and merging them into the internal styles array.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Helper static method that retrieves attributes from a SimpleXMLElement for a given namespace; returns an empty XML element if input is null.

methods.name: getSxml
methods.description: Helper static method that returns the given SimpleXMLElement if not null, or an empty XML element if null.
